reviews.author: Latoya Freeman
reviews.text: I highly recommend Manley Repair and Towing Service! From start to finish, their customer service was outstanding. Chris and his team were professional, knowledgeable, and stayed in constant communication throughout the entire process. After another repair shop made matters worse and couldn’t figure out how to fix my car, I brought it to Manley Repair and Towing, Chris and his team took the time to thoroughly troubleshoot the problem, identify the root cause, and repair it correctly. Their attention to detail and commitment to getting the job done right gave me confidence that my vehicle was in good hands. If you’re looking for an honest, dependable, and skilled repair shop that truly cares about its customers, Manley Repair and Towing Service is the place to go. Thank you, Chris, for your excellent work!

reviews.author: Raj Guendoo
reviews.text: Was returning home after a great week of vacation when one the worst fears happened. Flat tire on the interstate after hours and 2 hours from home. No spare, only run flat tires these days. Run flats got me into town but everything was closed. Even my manufacturer, Lexus, provided service would only take me 25 miles. Thank God for this place. Got a hold of Chris who got me up and running within an hour of calling. What could have been a really sour end to a great vacation was saved by his prompt response and professionalism. Thank you Chris for helping us get home!

reviews.author: Tash Michelle
reviews.text: Chris saved me from the side of a dark road in the middle of night when I had no one else to call. He was professional, genuine, and caring. Not only did he spend all day fixing my car, he found amazing prices for the parts. He communicated through the whole process and advocated for me during a time I was stressed and in a time crunch. He gave me all my options upfront. I appreciate how he handled me and enjoyed the laughs he gave to calm my spirit. It feels good to know there are still good people with exceptional service and integrity. I was able to continue my trip safely and return home without any more issues. I would definitely recommend Manley’s Repair & Tow Shop.

reviews.author: Hughshuree Battle
reviews.text: I had an outstanding experience from start to finish! Before I even met him in person, he was kind, professional, and reassuring over the phone, which immediately put me at ease during a stressful situation. Once he arrived, his attitude stayed just as positive. He was friendly, respectful, and took the time to explain everything to me. He towed my car safely and replaced my damaged tire with a brand-new one quickly and efficiently. You can tell he genuinely cares about helping people and takes pride in his work. He turned what could have been a frustrating experience into a smooth and stress-free one. If you’re ever in need of roadside assistance or a tow, I highly recommend him. Excellent customer service, outstanding professionalism, and an all-around great person. Thank you again for your help, I truly appreciate it!

reviews.author: Macey Tollison
reviews.text: I was pulling a cargo trailer o Baltimore and had a wheel emergency that put me on the side of the road. I made some calls, and found a gentlemen named Chris that went above and beyond in so many ways. He tried to get me back on the road same day, but we could not get the part. He worked me in on a Friday morning and acted like I was his only customer, when I know I wasn’t. I can’t say enough good things about him and this company. Thanks again Chris!

reviews.author: Michele Morgan
reviews.text: I cannot say enough good things about Manley's Auto Repair & Towing. What started as a stressful Memorial Day roadside situation turned into one of the kindest and most honest repair experiences I’ve ever had. I was driving home to DC after a long weekend in New Bern, NC, where my friend Sarah Fischer had just been made Bishop of the Diocese of East Carolina. Trying to beat the I-95 traffic, I left early even though my engine light had been on for a day or two. Then the overheating light came on. I carefully made it to the next exit, popped the hood, and hoped for the best. That’s when Chris, owner, tow guy, mechanic, and genuinely good human being, entered the story. I first saw him helping another stranded traveler from Georgia with a tire problem. When I asked him about my car, he listened carefully, explained things calmly, and suggested I try driving the two exits up to his shop, with instructions to stop immediately if it overheated again. Thankfully, it made the 8 miles. At the shop, Chris hooked the car up to diagnostics and quickly figured out why the engine light was on (apparently: don’t overfill your gas tank, kids). Then we discovered the real problem: a leaking water pump. Even though it was Memorial Day, Chris and Jessie found and ordered the part and stayed to install it. They charged me a fair price and got me safely back on the road so I could make it home and still spend the last couple of hours of my anniversary with my beloved. And the people in the office made the six-hour wait feel almost like hanging out with friends. Mrs. Ann was absolutely wonderful, talking with me, keeping me company, offering me chips, and even driving me to not one but TWO ATMs so I could avoid credit card fees. Truly above and beyond. Green Eyes (I never caught his real name!) was charming, funny, and kept everyone entertained. What could have been a terrible holiday experience became a reminder that good people still exist. If you ever find yourself stranded near Manly Repair and Tow, you are in caring, honest, capable hands.

reviews.author: Shelice Davis
reviews.text: 9 pm on a Saturday night our tire blew out 10 minutes before reaching va statelines... we called and reached Chris. He got us back on the road in no time. Chris was so kind and courteous we are extremely grateful, for the help he provided. I recommend this company for anyone in the NC area

reviews.author: Lauren Vazquez
reviews.text: We got stuck on a I-95 after stopping for gas and realizing our car had a slash in the tire. After trying so many “reputable or well known” service companies like Firestone and many others I came across this ad from the reviews. Chris was polite, respectful, punctual, genuine and honest and over all our saving grace! straight to business and had us on the road earlier than we projected.

reviews.author: Cevonne Carrillo
reviews.text: On the way to VA Beach tire belt snapped on 95 . There were 7 of us in the car including my 3 kids. One of the scariest moments of our lives, Turned into a blessing. Chris came and even his wife picked the rest of us up! They got us fixed and back on the road. Everyone at the shop was kind and helpful, Highly recommend 10 out of 10!

reviews.author: Z TECH27
reviews.text: I can't express enough how helpful, kind, patient, and caring Chris at Manleys Repair and towing was to me and my family. My vehicle broke down late at night, after calling many tow companies he came to the rescue expeditiously. He treated me like we were family and checked on us the next day. If I could give more than 5 stars I would. I am happy to know if I get stuck in NC I can call on him.

reviews.author: DJ Squared Labore
reviews.text: Traveling to Florida from Vermont we had a car failure about 20 miles North of Roanoke Springs. After getting the car to a hotel for the night Manly Auto was one of the only places with 24 hour service. Chris opened the shop for us and gave the entire electrical system a check and was able to determine an intermittent battery harness was likely the root of the problem. He was able to confirm proper computer, alternator and battery function, repaired the harness and sent us on our way. 100% recommend Manly Auto shop if your in a jam, and if your local, Chris and his shop is a gem that should be the go to shop! Thank you Chris!

reviews.author: Tynesha James
reviews.text: Quincy was amazing. He saved the day with bringing us fuel on the side on the side of busy I-95 on a Friday Afternoon! They were quick and in 20min we were all set! Definitely recommend 10/10!

reviews.author: 3tshirt Queens
reviews.text: I was stuck on side of the I95-N (very busy interstate that day) on the Virginia state line for 2 hrs before my roadside assistance found a towing service to come get me. Once Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC found out he was assigned to me he kept me informed on the ETA and gave me check-ins of his where abouts. He asked me about my vehicle to see if we could trouble shoot. As a mechanic he knew exactly what was the matter. My main focus was to make it back home which was 2 1/2 hrs away. When he arrived at my location, him and his employee was very friendly and helpful. My alternator had went bad on my car. I asked him to tow me to Walmart where I was just going to get me a need battery to at least make it close to home as possible. He offered to switch out my battery for me at his shop and even stated that he could fix my vehicle but it was a Saturday morning and my vehicle was under warranty and I didn’t know if the dealership would pay him that day. When we got to his shop he asked me if I was hungry, thirsty, or needed to use the restroom. He advised me to not ride with the radio or ac on to make my battery last longer to make it to my destination back to NC. He wanted me to follow through to make sure I made it home safety. I got a little nervous because after leaving his shop my battery light came on about 20 miles down the road and I instantly called him. He told me what to do and calmed me down because I was nervous. He even asked me where I was in case he needed to come get me right then. I made it about 11 miles from my house which I was more than blessed and ok with (further than I expected). There are still very good people in this world! I was frustrated from the time my car broke down, it was steaming hot, and the place I was located in wasn’t the best while trying to hold back my tears! Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC did me beyond right!!!! I would recommend their services to anyone!!!! If I could give them a 10 STAR RATING I WOULD!!!

reviews.author: Tara Tarantula
reviews.text: These guys were amazing. I had gotten a flat on 95 on my way to Florida, they had a guy come right to me to help me get my donut tire on then I was able to head right to the shop to have my new tire put on in no time at all. All on Memorial Day. Highly recommend, super friendly and easy service.

reviews.author: Angela Patterson
reviews.text: Ty Manley Repair and Towing!!! Chris and Kathy are amazing and friendly. Chris called after USAA contracted them for a tow, he made the special arrangements. Then his sweet wife Kathy came in her minivan to pick up all my family as well to get us where we needed to be. They really made a horrible situation with my family bearable. I really, really appreciate you both!!!!

reviews.author: Amanda McChesney
reviews.text: On a Sunday afternoon traveling from Virginia back to Florida. My car was shaking really bad and we couldn’t find any open mechanics or the ones that were open couldn’t help us. We called Chris and he was not only there and willing to help but he went above and beyond to ensure that we were safe to make it home. Highly recommend.Thank you Chris!!

reviews.author: Leah Harris
reviews.text: I’m not even from North Carolina and they have gained me as a customer moving forward. I won’t write a book but I will say that they are a very rare business that is trustworthy, honest and made sure I was good to make it back home in VA. Thanks Manley Repair and Towing service!!

reviews.author: Kat Stephenson
reviews.text: I cannot express how efficiently and quick these polite and curtious gentlemen were that helped us today. Which is part of their job! However, let me say this, their job does not consist of taking extra time to avoid an obstacle in their way. These 2 gentlemen came to tow out a truck that got stuck in the yard today which was at an angle between a pull trailer and my father in laws truck who passed in October. We were concerned bc of the angle this truck had backed in and gotten stuck that when being pulled out my FIL truck (less than 3ft away) would have gotten hit. I spoke with these two gentlemen about my concerns and worried Abt it hitting my late FIL truck. They really took to heart my concerns like it was their own family members truck and was cautious and confident to assure me they would not hit it. They took the time to be efficient curious and respectful of our feelings. That is not part of their job. That is being a human that cares something this world needs more of! GREAT JOB!!

reviews.author: Martin Wright
reviews.text: Solid guy, solid work. Timing belt went bad day after thanksgiving. helped me with repair and all options. Let me know it's best to check if rental company really had some cars. Not his job, but made a huge difference. Could have been a real nightmare, but was solid at every turn. Even when tires exploded during test drive (dry rot). Replaced those and all at real sweet price. When went back down to pick it up, gave me ride from rental place. Real good guy you can trust.

reviews.author: Courtney Turner
reviews.text: Excellent customer service, diagnostics and repair. Chris took care of our car and our daughter in an emergent situation while she was driving back to school. Thank you for helping us and making us feel comfortable in a stressful situation. Highly recommend this business and Chris! We are just amazed that you were available and fixed the problem so efficiently. Chris found the parts to replace 6 cylinders and our daughter was back on the road within a couple hours. He even made sure to check in that she made it back to school safely! Also, he was very fair with his pricing, especially for a Saturday.

reviews.author: Ashley Morrison
reviews.text: We were in NC passing thru to get home 100 miles away, when our car suddenly stopped. We realized a belt had come off during the wet and cold weather. These guys came within 40 minutes to tow us and were beyond nice and helpful. Turns out we needed a new tensioner and belt. They got the parts, fixed us up and had us going in just a few hours. So grateful for these guys, and their expertise! 10/10 recommend!

reviews.author: Marcus McDougal
reviews.text: Chris was awesome. He kept me informed on where he was and he had me hooked up and my vehicle towed in minutes. He gave me safe ride home and I was an hour away from home!!!

reviews.author: Jenn Papenfuse
reviews.text: I can't say enough nice things about Chris and Manley's towing. He towed my vehicle after I was in an accident an hour and a half from my home. He has been an absolute pleasure to work with, despite the terrible circumstances. Thank you, Chris!

reviews.author: Ashley Wagner
reviews.text: Our alternator died while traveling from NY to SC on Christmas Eve, leaving my grandmother, her tiny dog, and myself stranded at a gas station after 7 PM. It was such a relief when Chris answered the phone right away and said he was on his way to pick us up. With everything being closed until after Christmas, Chris loaded us in his pickup and drove us a couple exits up to where there were more hotels and restaurants so we could at least be comfortable over the holiday. He was in the shop early the morning after Christmas and had the alternator out, and was waiting at the parts store when they opened at 7:30. He was at our hotel to pick us up by 9:30 and had us on our way. We can not recommend and thank him enough for everything he did for us

reviews.author: Michaela Turner
reviews.text: I was driving and my check engine light started blinking. Found Manley’s and I’m so happy I did. I knew nothing about cars or anything and all of the workers were so kind and helpful. They towed my car and picked me up within maybe 5 minutes of calling. They fixed my car and got me back on the road in just a few hours which I doubt would’ve happened if I went anywhere else. If you need to go anywhere go to Manley’s. They even offered me a snack and water. They truly turned a horrible situation into a best case scenario. Couldn’t recommend them enough.

reviews.author: Aaron Joseph
reviews.text: I recently had an exceptional experience with Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC, and I cannot recommend them highly enough, particularly for their roadside assistance. When I found myself with a flat tire on a day when virtually no other businesses were available, Chris from Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC came to my rescue. Chris was incredibly professional from the moment he arrived. He quickly assessed the situation and demonstrated remarkable skill and efficiency in repairing my tire right there on the roadside. It was clear he possessed extensive knowledge and experience, making what could have been a very stressful situation completely manageable. Beyond his outstanding service, I was also very impressed with Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC's pricing. Their rates were refreshingly consumer-friendly, especially considering the urgent nature of the service and the lack of other available options. In a time of need, Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC, and Chris specifically, proved to be an invaluable resource. Their professionalism, skill, and fair pricing make them my go-to recommendation for anyone in need of reliable and efficient repair and towing services.

reviews.author: Fan Bender
reviews.text: Chris was absolutely fantastic!! Super-nice guy. We were from PA & stranded along I 95 on a Sunday morning. Chris got us fixed up & on our way again within 30 minutes & said "no charge." Of course we gave him a tip. If you ever need vehicle help while in Roanoke Springs, NC, Chris @ Manley Automotive is your man. Highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Myrna Goldberg
reviews.text: I was on I95 when my tire indicator light came on. I stopped in Emporia to add air and the tire was totally flat. The staff at the Pilot gave me Chris’ number. I didn’t have a spare (new cars apparently don’t have them) so he came and loaded my car, took it back to Roanoke Rapids, put on a new tire and had me back on the road in a little over two hours from our initial contact. Chris was very friendly and courteous the entire time. I would recommend his shop to anyone. I definitely will use his services again if needed.

reviews.author: Jared Skiwski
reviews.text: I had a piece of tire hit and damage my radiator while traveling from Florida to Maryland. I called Chris and he was professional and polite! He went above and beyond got my car towed and parts ordered. He took me into town to get some food and made sure I was taken care of beyond just my car. He is a stand up guy and a true professional and more importantly a good and genuine person. Couldn’t recommend his services enough! Truly 1 of a kind.

reviews.author: Heather Cooper
reviews.text: Can I give 100 stars?!? Because this company deserves it! He took incredible care of my husband when he had a blow out on his way to pick up our daughter. The man who responded was not only skilled in taking care of the flat and finding a replacement tire but he also recognized that some things are time sensitive so he hooked us with a temporary fix so my husband could pick up our daughter while waiting for the replacement tire to come in. He was looking for ways to say yes, ways to help, and did so in a truly human way! Thank you thank you thank you!

reviews.author: Amber B
reviews.text: I’m so late making this… Life! But late July Chris came to me at 2am on the side of 95 after roadside telling me they couldn’t find anyone and to contact the non emergency line to get a HP out there. I was beyond nervous and frazzled but he showed up and was so welcoming and nice. He tried to plug my tire and unfortunately it didn’t work, but did offer to take it to his shop where he had better tools for that, but I was already hours behind on my trip. He tested my donut tire, put it on, and got me on the road. He texted me and asked if I would let him know when I made it to New Jersey safe. I was traveling from SC to NJ. And that I did! Most definitely recommend Manley Repair!!!

reviews.author: melissa and david Luce
reviews.text: We were on our way home from a trip to Myrtle Beach when we had a tire shear off our camper, we called our insurance company and they said someone would be there in an hour or so.....Manley's was there within 10 minutes, very polite and professional. Took our camper back to his shop and did the repairs. worked with us as to when we could be back to NC to pick the camper back up. I couldn't be more happy with the service offered by this company! I highly recommend Chris Manley and his company. Melissa and David Luce

reviews.author: Aleah Costello
reviews.text: I don’t usually leave reviews, but the compassion, kindness, and humanity I experienced from Manley Repair and Towing Service LLC deserve to be recognized. I found myself stranded in a really tough situation, and without hesitation, Chris went above and beyond to help me. He didn’t just offer a service, he offered understanding, patience, and a genuine effort to work with me and get me back home safely. In a moment where everything felt overwhelming, Chris showed up like a gift from God. It wasn’t just what he did, it was how he did it: with heart, care, and integrity. If you ever need help, I pray you find someone like Chris. Manley Repair and Towing isn’t just a company, it’s a lifeline, run by someone who truly cares. Thank you from the bottom of my heart.

reviews.author: Trevon D
reviews.text: My Chevy Sonic broke down on the interstate after hours last night and I had my car towed to these guys. They diagnosed an issue with my alternator belt this morning and had it replaced and had me back on the road the same day! Excellent, timely service, they were even willing to pick me up from the motel down the road. Good guys, great service, will come back to them the next time I need repairs!

reviews.author: Gloria Rogers
reviews.text: Mr. Chris was my savior last night. He came and got me off the road by the time I got back to the shot where he was at. He then told me what was wrong with my truck and I am already ready to go back out to get back on the road to get my trailers delivered. So shout out to this man right here

reviews.author: Autum Feher
reviews.text: Driving from Ny - Fl and stopped for gas in NC. Next thing we know we have a flat and it’s midnight, no spare in the rental vehicle. Called triple A and all they did was continuously “redirect us” which resulted in us starting from square one with new representatives over and over. Chris called us and was able to get our tire fixed and us back on the road safely within 1-1 1/2 hour. So, so grateful for his prompt service!!

reviews.author: ryan heuston
reviews.text: Chris and his mom were awesome! I had a U joint that came apart on I-95. They dropped me off at the hotel and picked me up at the hotel. Chris drove 30 miles to go get me a new driveshaft, so I could get back on the road. They go Above and beyond to help you out. Just good people. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Courtney Boyette
reviews.text: Used Manley Repair this evening for an unexpected situation while traveling 95 and they were absolutely wonderful! Chris was accomodating, extremely professional and paid extra attention to detail with my tires. I will definitely be returning to them for business! Highly recommend! Go check them out!

reviews.author: Kim Harrison
reviews.text: We stopped by Manley Repair & Towing Service in Roanoke Rapids with our 2011 Acura MDX, and Chris, the owner and mechanic, took care of us right away. He diagnosed the issue, replaced the starter, and had us back on the road in about an no time! Chris was professional, friendly, and clearly very knowledgeable. It’s rare to find someone who not only fits you in last minute but also does quality work so efficiently. We’re truly grateful for his help and highly recommend Manley Repair & Towing Service to anyone needing honest and reliable auto repairs. Thank you, Chris!

reviews.author: Nicole White
reviews.text: I wish I could give these guys more than 5 stars. I had an issue with my RV at 4 am and when I called him, his response time was faster than anytime I have ever called AAA. I have an older model RV and the part I needed we had to wait for the parts store open. He got us up and running by 10 am on a Sunday! Fastest I have ever had anything done and fixed ready to go! I travel for work and have shared his info with others that travel thru this area. His rates, knowledge and turn around time is incredible as well as their professionalism.

reviews.author: Seymore Truth
reviews.text: Chris Manley is an absolute legend, I busted the elbow on my secondary air tank and I initially thought it was the tank drain plug, Chris came out within 20 minutes of calling him. He went above and beyond what anyone could expect, he got me fixed up in no time, easily the best experience I’ve had, he’s certainly a man amongst men in the industry. God bless you Chris and again I can’t thank you enough for getting me back on the road asap.

reviews.author: Tercell Carter
reviews.text: Manley Repair is highly recommended! Beyond knowledgeable regarding mechanical issues, very professional and efficient. He had my truck back on the road within a few hours of receiving the parts. Thank you for your assistance and I will be spreading the word around town.

reviews.author: Crystal Carpenter (keptincrys)
reviews.text: AMAZING wonderful helpful service! Chris was very quick to find the tires we needed and get back on our way with road-side help. Double blow-out with our camper tires fixed quickly and with great service :) thanks so much!

reviews.author: CHA'DAE SIMMS
reviews.text: I was traveling back home from Maryland. My insurance had me on the road since 1am for 3 hours and Manley drove to me instantly just to come place oil in my car when I thought it was my tire. He was so professional .

reviews.author: Ann VanAlsburg
reviews.text: Chris Manley was very skilled and helpful. His service was excellent and he helped us get back on the road quickly. I highly recommend Manleys Repair and Towing!

reviews.author: Demetria Alston
reviews.text: They are so helpful and do a great job to take care of your vehicle. Very respectful and concern to have you on the road driving safe.

reviews.author: Emerson Campos
reviews.text: Was stranded in the middle of nowhere in NC and I’m from northern VA thought I wasn’t going to be able to go home but Chris helped me and my siblings out to get home safe I wouldn’t be home now if it wasn’t for him thank you Chris!

reviews.author: Monique Turner
reviews.text: I am very pleased with the efficiency of service from Manley Towing and Repair service. From tow pick up to accident repair! Manley & associates were swift, persistent, and thorough!

reviews.author: Rod Maz
reviews.text: I was headed to Virginia and cracked my rim Chris went above and beyond to get me back on the road. Highly recommend!!!

reviews.author: Reginald Best
reviews.text: Manley is an all right guy. He helps out in a clutch and is willing to go over and beyond to lend a helping hand. Call this guy 1st! If he can't help you, he'll tell you who can.

reviews.author: Ileana
reviews.text: Great experience, they saved me when I was stranded and fixed my car quickly at a reasonable price. Thank you!

reviews.author: Ja'Onna Jacobs
reviews.text: Helped me out on an early Saturday morning without hesitation, great customer service and price! Very fast work! Would recommend 10/10

reviews.author: James Turpyn
reviews.text: Chris towed us after we broke down. Got us fixed up in his shop and back on the road. Thanks so much Chris!

reviews.author: M Bow
reviews.text: Very efficient, well mannered and professional. They made us feel comfortable during our crisis as they got us back on the road. Very grateful!

reviews.author: Sebernia Turner
reviews.text: This company is extremely professional yet maintain the ability to provide excellent customer service!

reviews.author: Bryant Leone
reviews.text: Chris saved us!! We were coming home from vacation Saturday night, heard a bad noise, so we got a hotel. I went out in the morning to find out we lost 3 lugnuts and broke a stud. Call Chris around 8am Sunday morning and he came right over, got our vehicle, fixed it, and brought it back all before our check out time. Top notch service and a great person. Thanks again Stew and Bri 2016 Honda Pilot

reviews.author: Patricia Stone
reviews.text: A month or so ago, my husband, myself, our dog Eddy were driving from Maine to Florida. Long story short, our Rivian had an issue and we broke down in North Carolina. We figured it would be hours before anyone could help us, plus we had to find Rivian service, which was no easy task! We also had a big dog with us, so further complicating an already difficult situation. We expected the worst, until Chris showed up from Manleys repair and Towing within a half hour, like a knight in shining armour!! He towed our vehicle, and all of us, including Eddy, an hour away to the closest Rivian dealer! Chris is professional, efficient, and just a great guy! He was SO helpful, we don’t know what we would have done without him! We highly recommend Manleys Repair and Towing!! Thanks Chris, you’re the BEST!
